fields.title: Apple CarPlay compatibility
fields.description: Narrated books (and podcasts) play through Apple CarPlay: browsable library, now-playing screen, play/pause/skip/rate, position saved. A listening surface only (platform audio templates). Android Auto moved into ANDROID-APP-1 by owner direction 2026-11-03 (roadmap review 2026-11-03-2).
